chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about a man who prays and a bird is in his sleeve. He said: If he fears it flying away, there is no problem.
He said: And I asked him about the anklets, is it permissible for women and children to wear them? He said: If they are silent, there is no problem, and if they have a sound, then no.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for women to wear anklets during prayer if they make sound?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Reza (AS) clarifies that a bird in the sleeve does not invalidate prayer unless it causes significant distraction, reflecting the Shia principle of ease in worship. Additionally, he distinguishes between silent (صماء) and noisy anklets, permitting the former for women and children while prohibiting the latter to avoid the distraction of sound during salāt.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about a man who prays Salāt and in his sleeve is a bird. Heasws said: ‘If he fears the fleeing over it, so there is no problem’.

And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the anklets, is it correct for the women and the children to wear these?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When these were silent, so there is no problem, and if there was a sound to it, so no’.
en.sarwar: 33. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy from Ali ibn Ja‘far who has said the following:
“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performed Salah (prayer) with a bird in his sleeve. He (the Imam) said, ‘If he is afraid about it then it is not harmful.’

He (the narrator) has said that he then asked him (the Imam) about anklets if women and children could use them during Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not an offense if they are silent, but if they make noise then it is not permissible.’”
